knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Checking yourself first and recording facts keeps the response proportionate and evidence-based.
The opening names the behaviour, its setting and its effect, without attacking the person's character.
Continuing or hurtful behaviour after a private conversation is referred with written notes. Leads are not expected to handle everything alone.

practicalCriteria: The learner writes dated notes for a supplied scenario that name the behaviour, the people present and the effect on the job.
The learner role-plays a private conversation that uses a specific description, asks what the person values and agrees one action and a later date to check it.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Role-play observation with follow-up date recorded
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any incident involving threats, violence or harassment to the supervisor immediately.
Stop and refer any case where the lead is not authorised to take the action proposed.
